text: AI is changing the way we think about creativity. Today, computers can create art, compose music, and even write stories. These tools learn from huge amounts of data and then produce something new. Some people are amazed by this, while others feel worried. Can a machine really be creative, or is it just copying? Human creativity comes from emotions, experiences, and imagination. AI can support artists by giving them new ideas, but it cannot feel joy or sadness. Perhaps the best results happen when humans and AI work together.
